_help: Announcements shown inside abyss. Edit this file and push to main: every running app picks it up within 3 hours (or when someone presses 'check for updates'). Fields: id (unique, required), title, body, level (info | update | warning | important), link {label, url (https only)}, date, start / end (YYYY-MM-DD), minVersion / maxVersion, platforms (["windows", "linux"]), dismissible (default true). See README → Announcements.

announcements.title: welcome to abyss 0.2 ✦
announcements.body:
abyss is now open source and rebuilt from scratch in Rust: it opens in under a second, and updates install themselves.
found a bug or have an idea? tell us on github.
